property.name: Casa Corsica
property.tagline: Your home away from home on the Weskus
property.address: Casa Corsica, Shelley Point, St Helena Bay, South Africa

welcome.greeting: Welkom and welcome to Casa Corsica! We are so happy you chose our little piece of the West Coast. Kick off your shoes, open the doors to the sea air and make yourself at home. Everything you need to know for a slow, salty, sun-filled stay is in this guide — and if anything is missing, just give us a shout.
welcome.checkInNotes: Unless organised prior to check in, self check-in from 15:00. The key lockbox is to the left of the front door — your code is sent the morning of arrival.
welcome.parking: Up to three cars can fit diagonally in the driveway in front of the No. 17 Garage — Shelley Point is a secure estate and your vehicle will be safe. Please don't park as to obstruct other vehicles on the street or in front of the neighbour's garage.

local.name: Shelley Point Lighthouse
local.description: A brief walk / drive to the historic lighthouse named Stompneuspunt perched North East edge of the estate with sweeping views of the ocean. Either take a short walk from the front door to or drive to the designated parking area. Proceeed with a brief walk on the beach, panoramic vistas and photo opportunities await.
local.mapsQuery: Shelley Point Lighthouse, St Helena Bay

local.name: Shelley Point (West) Beach Walk
local.description: A sheltered, crescent-shaped beach right on your doorstep. Perfect for sunrise walks, beachcombing for shells and a safe paddle in the calm bay. Whilst facing the ocean from the parking area, turn left and head along the beach - heading south.

local.name: Shelley Point (North) Beach Walk
local.description: A rugged walk next to the hills of mussels. Perfect for sunrise walks, beachcombing for shells and spotting wildlife. Whilst facing the ocean from the parking area, turn right and head along a path to the north.

local.name: Whale & Dolphin Spotting
local.description: From June to November, southern right and humpback whales visit the bay. Grab the binoculars from the hall cupboard and head to the point at high tide. Whales and Dolphins are often spotted from the beach and the lighthouse. The whales are usually closer to the point, while dolphins are often seen in the bay.

local.name: Shelley Point Golf Course | Tennis | Lawn Bowls
local.description: A scenic 9-hole links course overlooking the ocean. Visitors welcome — book a tee time at the clubhouse or simply enjoy a sundowner on the terrace. Also available: tennis courts and lawn bowls. Booking required.
local.mapsQuery: Shelley Point Golf Club, St Helena Bay

local.name: Surfing at Shelley Point
local.description: Called 'Heaven', catch waves at the sheltered, crescent-shaped beach right on your doorstep (in the estate). The calm bay offers excellent conditions for both beginners and experienced surfers. Bring your own board.

local.name: Flagship Weekend market
local.description: Weekends, the market (informal) is open on most weekends just outside the estate. A great spot to pick up great coffee and pancakes, local crafts.

townOver.name: Paternoster Village & Waterfront
townOver.description: One of the oldest fishing villages on the West Coast — whitewashed cottages, colourful boats on the beach and some of South Africa's best seafood, wine and dining. To the men, checkout the Toy museum at the Waterfront.

townOver.name: Berg River Estuary & Bokkomlaan
townOver.description: Flamingos, pelicans and over 200 bird species on the estuary. Stroll Bokkomlaan's historic fishing sheds, now home to galleries and riverside cafés.

townOver.name: Drikus Horse Trails Paternoster
townOver.description: A must! A scenic horseback ride along the beach and through the dunes and Private Nature reserve near Paternoster. Perfect for families and horse lovers looking for a unique way to explore the beautiful West Coast. Avoid windy days. Booking essential.

townOver.name: Cape Columbine Nature Reserve
townOver.description: Granite boulders, wild coves and the last manned lighthouse in South Africa. Spectacular wildflowers in spring (Aug–Sep). Bring a picnic. Cape Columbine Nature Reserve Tietiesbaai is a 263-hectare coastal reserve on the West Coast near the fishing village of Paternoster in the Western Cape, South Africa, protecting the rocky headland of Cape Columbine and the small inlet of Tieties Bay. The reserve is home to the Cape Columbine Lighthouse, commissioned in 1936 and noted as the last manually controlled lighthouse built on the South African coast, its light standing about 80 metres above sea level and visible for roughly 50 kilometres. Rugged shoreline, fynbos slopes and tidal rock pools make the reserve popular for hiking, coastal birdwatching and seaside camping, and it is managed by the Saldanha Bay Municipality about 5 kilometres from Paternoster.

townOver.name: Fine Dining in Paternoster
townOver.description: World Class restaurants in Paternoster, including Wolfgat, Leeto and . Booking essential.

townOver.name: Daai Plekkie in die Weskus (Restaurant & Jacobs Bay)
townOver.description: A stunning gem on the West Coast. A restaurant with a view and a small town to explore.
townOver.mapsQuery: Daai Plekkie in die Weskus, Jacobs Bay, Western Cape

townOver.name: Tietiesbaai
townOver.description: A literal translation of tieties from Afrikaans ('tieties' or 'boobies') points to two large, smooth, dome-like round boulders on the coastline that resemble a pair of breasts. A popular picnic spot with a small tidal pool for kids to paddle in.

townOver.name: Charlie's Brewhouse
townOver.description: A local microbrewery offering a selection of craft beers and a relaxed atmosphere on the canals of Port Owen in Veldrif. A great spot to sample regional brews and enjoy a casual drink.

dayTrip.name: West Coast National Park & Langebaan
dayTrip.description: A turquoise lagoon, empty beaches and the famous Postberg flower section in spring. Great for kitesurfing, birding and long lunches.

dayTrip.name: Darling Brewery / Wine Route
dayTrip.description: Charming little town with wine farms, a local brewery and quirky shops. Pair a tasting with a farm lunch for the perfect lazy day.

dayTrip.name: Elands Bay & Birding
dayTrip.description: Elands Bay is a quiet coastal surf and nature village on the Western Cape's West Coast. Surfing: Tackle the renowned, world-class left-hand surf break off Baboon Point / Elands Bay Beach. Elands Bay Cave & Baboon Point: Walk up the cliffs above the harbour to explore ancient San and Khoe rock art, handprints, and archaeological layers dating back thousands of years while enjoying panoramic ocean views. Bird Watching & Kayaking at Verlorenvlei: Visit the Verlorenvlei estuary, a vital RAMSAR wetland and birding hotspot that hosts a vast array of waterbirds and species.

dayTrip.name: Lamberts Bay & Birding
dayTrip.description: Lambert's Bay is a charming fishing village on the South African West Coast, known for its seafood, wildlife, and relaxed coastal atmosphere. Muisbosskerm Open Air Restaurant: a legendary, world-renowned West Coast seafood buffet located right on the beach just outside Lambert's Bay. Widely recognized as the pioneer of the open-air beach 'braai' (barbecue) dining concept. Bird Island Nature Reserve: A 3-hectare island connected to the mainland by a breakwater where you can walk among thousands of breeding Cape gannets, Cape cormorants, and Cape fur seals.

dayTrip.name: Cederberg Wilderness
dayTrip.description: Dramatic sandstone formations, ancient rock art and rooibos country. Hike to the Wolfberg Cracks or swim in a mountain rock pool.

items.name: Alegria (Portuguese restaurant)
items.description: A family-run Portuguese restaurant with a warm welcome and authentic flavours. Top notch seafood and traditional dishes with a lovely view of the bay. Local beer on tap as well. Booking recommended in Summer.

items.name: Die See Ster
items.description: An 'all-rounder' popular local spot for casual dining with a relaxed atmosphere. Known for their hearty portions and friendly service. You must take home some carrot cake cupcakes for later or purchase their cake if your second time.
items.mapsQuery: Die See Ster Kombuis, St Helena Bay

items.name: Harbour View
items.description: This restaurant has a lovely ambience with very friendly staff. A fine dining experience for St Helena Bay, great wine selection and often has daily specials.
items.mapsQuery: Harbour View Restaurant, St Helena Bay

items.name: Voorstrandt Restaurant
items.description: The iconic red tin shed on the beach in Paternoster. Fresh crayfish, linefish and your toes in the sand. Booking essential in Summer.

items.name: Wolfgat
items.description: World-renowned tasting menu of West Coast ingredients in a 130-year-old cottage above the sea. Book well in advance, once in lifetime experience.

items.name: Laaiplek Hotel Restaurant
items.description: Classic seaside hotel dining at the mouth of the Berg River — great fish & chips and harbour views.

items.name: Shelley Point Clubhouse
items.description: Really affordable option for breakfasts, Wiesenhof coffee and great lunches, has a kiddies jungle gym as well.
items.mapsQuery: Shelley Point Community Centre and Golf Club, St Helena Bay

items.name: Jud's (St Helena Bay Nursery & Coffee Shop)
items.description: Linked to a nursery, this restaurant has a one of a kind atmosphere and one of a kind views, great spot for kids and lots of good food paired with a little giftshop.
items.mapsQuery: St Helena Bay Nursery & Coffee Shop

items.name: Whales' Tale
items.description: Amazing view, good breakfasts! Has a kiddies jungle gym as well.
items.mapsQuery: Whale's Tail Restaurant, St Helena Bay

items.name: Nicci's Coffee Club
items.mapsQuery: Niccis Coffee Club, St Helena Bay

items.name: Columbine Co. - Riverside Café
items.description: Amazing Coffee and homemade cakes, pastries, right on the estuary. Spot the flamingos while you sip. Not the best sit-and-view but the best coffee in town.

items.name: The Daily - your working café
items.description: If you are looking for a place to work, this is my favourite. Great working spaces with charging points, good coffee and food, a bit of a drive but worth it if you need to get some serious work done.
items.mapsQuery: Weskus The Daily Coffee Cafe, Vredenburg

items.name: Poetsies
items.description: A charming local café with great daily specials and homemade treats. Perfect for a quick lunch or afternoon tea. The friendliest people in town.
items.mapsQuery: Poetsies Gifts & Deli, St Helena Bay

items.name: Cathy's Kitchen Paternoster
items.description: Cathy's Kitchen is an initiative of the Paternoster Project NPC. Cathy's Kitchen serves breakfast & light meals. Local & sustainable.

items.name: Shelley Point Clubhouse
items.description: Local is lekker - Really affordable option for breakfasts, lunches, drinks, great for sport events as well and general atmosphere, has a kiddies jungle gym as well.
items.mapsQuery: Shelley Point Golf Club, St Helena Bay

items.name: Noordblinder Sports Bar
items.description: Probably the best Sports Bar in town - the local waterhole or best place to for a last drink. Usually has live music on Sundays, known for sport events as well
items.mapsQuery: Noordblinder Sports Bar, St Helena Bay

items.name: Knor Varkie (St Helena Bay)
items.description: Some of our favourite meals are from here. Projector for Sports events, good music and friendly staff, daily specials and a great vibe.

items.name: Local Supermarket
items.description: For everyday essentials, bread, milk and braai wood. Closest option for quick top-ups.

items.name: Weskus Mall
items.description: Large supermarkets (Woolworths / Checkers / Foodlovers), liquor stores, a pharmacy and banks — a bit of a drive, but best for a big stock-up shop.

houseGuide.title: Kitchen & appliances
houseGuide.body: The coffee machine takes Nespresso compatible pods. The oven, hob and dishwasher instructions are in the bottom drawer in the kitchen. Please rinse plates before loading the dishwasher please note that a limited number of dishwasher tablets are provided.

houseGuide.title: Trash & recycling
houseGuide.body: General waste goes in the black bin. Dispose of full / smelly bags in the green Wheelee bin outside. Bins go out on the verge on Wednesday evening for Thursday morning collection.

houseGuide.title: Heating & air-conditioning
houseGuide.body: The main bedroom has an aircon unit — remote is on or in the bedside table. Set to 22°C for comfort and please switch off when you go out or open the doors. Fan and heater can be found in the down stairs bedroom cupboard.

houseGuide.title: TV & streaming
houseGuide.body: The smart TV has Netflix and DSTV app — if you do log in with your own accounts, remember to log out before you leave. Use the grey remote for the TV and the small black one for the soundbar. Please let us know if they have been logged out and need to sign back in.

houseGuide.title: Power outages (load-shedding)
houseGuide.body: We have a small battery backup that keeps the Wi-Fi running during outages.

houseGuide.title: Water & hot water
houseGuide.body: Tap water is safe to drink. The West Coast is water-scarce, so please keep showers short. Hot water is geyser-heated — pipes run in the floor of the passage between the bedrooms if noticing a warm floor. If the hot water runs out, please wait 30–40 minutes for the geyser to reheat.

houseGuide.title: Braai (barbecue)
houseGuide.body: The built in braai is yours to enjoy. Tongs and a grill brush are in the cupboard to the right of the braai. Please make sure coals are completely out before you go to bed, and never leave a hot braai unattended. Please do not dispose of hot ash in the bin. Additional Braai wood can be purchased from the local supermarket.

houseGuide.title: Quiet hours
houseGuide.body: Quiet hours are 22:00 – 07:00. Please keep music and voices low after 22:00 out of respect for our neighbours.

houseGuide.title: House rules
houseGuide.body: No smoking or vaping indoors. No parties or events. Maximum occupancy is as booked. Pets by prior arrangement only. Please keep beach sand outside — there is an outdoor tap in the garden.

houseGuide.title: Late check-out
houseGuide.body: Check-out is at 10:00. Late check-out until 12:00 may be possible if we don't have guests arriving — please message us the day before and we'll do our best.

houseGuide.title: Check-out checklist
houseGuide.body: Load and start the dishwasher, take out the trash, switch off aircons and lights, close all windows, lock the doors and return the key to the lockbox. That's it — safe travels!

houseGuide.title: What is that smell?
houseGuide.body: Situated nearby, Lucky Star is a commercial fish processing plant. On some days, the wind carries a whiff of fishy aroma — it's not us, we promise!

suggestions.intro: Loved something? Missed something? We read every note and use your ideas to make Casa Corsica even better for the next guest.

art.intro: Some artwork found in Casa Corsica is by DGrout, a Cape Town artist inspired by the light, textures and colours of the bay. If a piece speaks to you, we'd love to put you in touch.
